user.title: Filament Manager
user.description: What do you want to add?

hub.title: Add a filament box
hub.description: Every hub is one filament box (or shelf); its spools are added afterwards from the hub's entry (the "+ Add" button). Leave the humidity limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box; leave the maximum number of spools empty for no limit.

reconfigure.title: Edit filament box
reconfigure.description: Update the box's name, humidity, notification and spool-limit settings. Leave the limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box.

cloud.title: Bambu cloud account
cloud.description: Optional: reads your Bambu filament library (read-only) so spools can follow its remaining amount. If the cloud does not answer, everything keeps working as before. Your password is not stored, only the login token.

cloud_code.title: Verification code
cloud_code.description: Bambu has sent a code to {email}.

cloud_tfa.title: Two-factor code
cloud_tfa.description: Enter the code of your authenticator app.

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the filament box.
error.invalid_auth: Login rejected - check e-mail and password.
error.blocked: The Bambu cloud blocked the request. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bambu cloud.

abort.already_configured: This Bambu account is already connected.

user.title: Add a filament spool
user.description: What kind of spool is it?

details.title: Spool details
details.description: Total weight is suggested from the material/manufacturer you picked where known, otherwise a generic default - always editable.

data.ams_sync_remaining: Follow the AMS remaining amount (spools with RFID only)
data.cloud_spool: Bambu cloud spool (– = automatic by RFID)

name.title: Name the spool
name.description: Suggested from the material, color and manufacturer you picked. Feel free to change it.

reconfigure.title: Edit spool
reconfigure.description: Update the spool's details. Use the remaining-weight entity or the consume_filament / refill_spool services to change how much filament is left.

data.name: Name
data.ams_sync_remaining: Follow the AMS remaining amount (spools with RFID only)
data.box: Filament box (changing it moves the spool)
data.cloud_spool: Bambu cloud spool (– = automatic by RFID)

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the spool.
error.remaining_exceeds_total: The remaining weight cannot be greater than the total weight.
error.box_unavailable: The spool cannot be moved: that filament box is not available right now.
error.box_full: That filament box is already full.

abort.box_full: This filament box is already full.
abort.moved: The spool "{spool}" now lives in "{box}". Its entities and history were kept.

consume_filament.name: Consume filament
consume_filament.description: Reduces a spool's remaining weight by the given amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount of filament used, in grams.

refill_spool.name: Refill spool
refill_spool.description: Resets a spool's remaining weight, e.g. after mounting a fresh one.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New remaining weight in grams. If left empty, the spool is reset to its total weight.

load_spool.name: Load spool into printer
load_spool.description: Assigns a spool to an AMS slot of a Bambu Lab printer. The spool that was assigned to this slot before is taken out.

slot.name: AMS slot
slot.description: The tray sensor of the Bambu Lab integration.

unload_spool.name: Take spool out of printer
unload_spool.description: Removes a spool's AMS slot assignment.

move_spool.name: Move spool to another box
move_spool.description: Moves a spool to another filament box and keeps its entities and history.

add_spool.name: Add spool
add_spool.description: Adds a spool to a filament box.

name.name: Name
name.description: If empty, built from manufacturer, material and color.

total_weight.name: Total weight
total_weight.description: In grams; suggested from material and manufacturer if empty.

remaining_weight.name: Remaining weight
remaining_weight.description: In grams; defaults to the total weight.

remove_spool.name: Remove spool
remove_spool.description: Deletes a spool with its device and entities.

box_not_found.message: The filament box was not found.

box_unavailable.message: The filament box "{box}" is not available right now.

box_full.message: The filament box "{box}" is already full.

slot_unknown.message: "{slot}" is not an AMS slot of the Bambu Lab integration.
